title: Who we are
statements: CapyStudio is a small studio that builds useful tools.

AI agents are starting to do real work, and real work deserves real standards. We think trust in agents should be earned with evidence: their runs readable, their failures explainable, their behavior graded on more than the final answer. We build the tools that make that kind of honesty practical.

We're equally interested in the other side of automation: the human advantage. As machines take over more of the doing, judgment, taste, and asking the right question matter more, and we build tools that put people in a position to exercise them.
